messages.author: ff83d20aaaea86d1
messages.subject: Error in Generating Visual Report
parts:
Hello, 

I am running a 24-hr accelerometer data and encountered this error when generating visual report: 

Warning message:
In readRDS(path) : error reading  from connection

I used this script:
library(GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(
  mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
  datadir="C:/Users/jp30/Desktop/Data",
  outputdir="C:/Users/jp30/Desktop/output",
  do.report=c(2,4,5),
  do.imp=TRUE,
  windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),
  do.enmo = TRUE,
  do.anglez = TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 2
  #=====================
  strategy = 1,
  hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
  maxdur = 1,                 includedaycrit = 16,
  qwindow=c(0,24),
  mvpathreshold =c(100),
  bout.metric = 4,
  excludefirstlast = FALSE,
  includenightcrit = 16,
  #=====================
  # Part 3 + 4
  #=====================
  anglethreshold = 5, 
  timethreshold = 5, 
  ignorenowear = TRUE,
  def.noc.sleep = 1,
  outliers.only = TRUE,
  criterror = 4,
  do.visual = TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
  boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
  includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("WW"),
  visualreport=TRUE)

Thanks for your help in advance.

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error in Generating Visual Report
parts:
Probably issue with your working directory, see:
https://community.rstudio.com/t/error-in-readrds-rds-file-name-here-error-reading-from-connection/11192
and
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/31935516/installing-r-packages-error-in-readrdsfile-error-reading-from-connection/55997765
